prompt: Production sprite art for an old partly abandoned American neighborhood 2D exploration game. Same old wooden door assembly in both, identical thick jambs and lintel, same front facing toward screen bottom, identical scale and bottom threshold baseline at y440. Frame footprint x80..300 in each cell, top about y75. Substantial dark warm wooden frame with chiselled moldings, chipped sage-green paint over brown wood, scratched bronze hinges and small latch, weathered limestone threshold with stepped top face, a few cracks at the jamb feet. Show broad TOP surface of lintel and threshold from above, but a compressed vertical door face. Neither side of frame converges. LEFT cell: door CLOSED, aged paneled wood with readable inset panels, old bronze handle; no planks nailed across it. RIGHT cell: same door OPEN, door leaf swung inward and tucked against LEFT jamb, keep center open and generous for a person to walk through. Fill the aperture with the SAME flat magenta as outside (it will be removed), not a room or scene. No surrounding wall wings, no roof. Full frame and threshold visible in both states. This is a tactile doorway sprite for a map, NOT a straight-on concept sketch. Please make the open and closed architecture match exactly.
